verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server (github.com/Adyen/adyen-mcp, run via `npx -y @adyen/mcp`) for TEST and LIVE environments. It exposes Checkout, payment-link, modification and Management API tools, supports tool subsetting, and authenticates with scoped API credentials whose required roles are documented; a probe confirms the docs page exists. missing for 10: server is labeled Alpha (maturity/stability unproven), no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully connecting.
